narration: The same money, a different life. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} parted first, that same month, with more of your pay committed before each month began. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. Its Freedom finished {freedom_gap}, a larger share of each month's pay still its own to decide.
